common.demoNote: Demo mode: supplier, batch and QR records persist in localStorage — no backend or database is connected.
common.notFoundHint: The link is wrong or the record was removed. Return to the list and try again.
common.noResultsHint: Change the search conditions and try again (UC-07 E2).
common.storageError: A storage error occurred — the data is unchanged, please try again.
common.cancelBody: The entered information will not be saved.

dashboard.title: Registration clerk dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Current state of supplier, batch and QR registration.
dashboard.workflowHint: Follow the sequence from supplier to QR code step by step.
dashboard.stepBatchHint: Enter the supplier, amount and origin.
dashboard.stepNumberHint: The system generates an MN-YYYY-000001 number automatically.
dashboard.stepQrHint: Create a QR link to the batch's public page.
dashboard.stepTraceHint: Trace the registry, supplier and quality links.
dashboard.emptyHint: The first batch appears here once registered.

supplier.listSubtitle: Search and filter suppliers, create a new record and edit permitted data (UC-04, UC-07).
supplier.createSubtitle: A record created by a registration clerk is active immediately (BR-12).
supplier.editSubtitle: Edit the permitted fields. Only an administrator changes the status (UC-04, FR-2.6).

hint.username: The supplier signs in with this name. It must be unique.

error.name: Enter the name.
error.usernameTaken: This username is already registered. Choose another one (UC-04 E3).
error.duplicateSupplier: A supplier with the same phone or email already exists (BR-13, UC-04 E3).
error.summary: Required fields are missing or invalid — fix the marked fields.
error.storage: The supplier record was not saved. A storage error occurred — the data is unchanged (UC-04 E4).

supplier.successCreateBody: The record was created in the active state (BR-12).
supplier.detailSubtitle: Registry information, supplies, batches and origin links.
supplier.newBatch: Register a batch for this supplier
supplier.newBatchUnavailable: The supplier must be active to register a batch.
supplier.noSuppliesHint: Supplies appear here once the supplier registers one.
supplier.noBatchesHint: Batches appear here once registered for this supplier.
supplier.readOnlyStatus: Only an administrator manages the status.
supplier.notFoundHint: The supplier ID is wrong or the record was removed.

batch.listSubtitle: Raw cashmere batches from every supplier — search, filter, edit and trace origin (UC-05, UC-07).
batch.registerSubtitle: Choose a supplier and enter the amount and origin. The system generates the batch number and checks for duplicates (UC-05).
batch.sectionSupplierHint: Every batch must link to exactly one registered supplier (BR-02).
batch.sectionDetailsHint: Enter the received raw cashmere amount and registration date.
batch.sectionOriginHint: Enter the cashmere's origin and livestock count.
batch.noSupplierHint: Register a supplier first, then a batch can be registered.
batch.supplyHint: Optional: select a supply record to prefill the amount and origin.
batch.numberHint: Generated by the system and immutable (FR-2.4).
batch.numberUnique: The number is unique — ready to save (FR-2.5).
batch.numberDuplicate: This number is already registered. Generate a new number (BR-01).

error.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
error.livestock: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
error.summary: Required fields are missing or invalid — fix the marked fields (UC-05 E2).
error.duplicate: The batch number is duplicated, so it was not saved. The system must generate a new number (UC-05 E3, BR-01).
error.storage: The batch was not saved. A storage error occurred — the whole registration was rolled back (UC-05 E4).
error.supplierMissing: The selected supplier does not exist. Choose again (UC-05 E2, BR-02).

batch.cancelBody: The entered data will be discarded and no batch registered (UC-05 A1).
batch.successBody: The batch was linked to its supplier and received a unique number (UC-05).
batch.detailSubtitle: Core batch data, supplier, origin, quality and QR status.
batch.editSubtitle: The number, quality result and status do not change (FR-2.6, BR-06).
batch.sectionInfoHint: Edit the permitted fields. The number stays immutable.
batch.sectionEditOriginHint: Edit the batch origin and livestock count.
batch.qualityHint: It appears here once the quality officer records the test result (UC-08).
batch.qualityReadOnly: Only the quality officer records quality parameters — the registration clerk cannot edit them (BR-06).
batch.qrMissingHint: Once a QR code is generated for the batch, it can be downloaded and printed (UC-06).
batch.traceHint: Batch → supplier → supply → quality → QR link.
batch.notFoundHint: The batch number is wrong or the record was removed (UC-07 E2).

search.title: Find a batch
search.subtitle: Search by batch number, supplier, origin, status, year or QR status (UC-07).
search.noResultsHint: Change the search conditions and try again (UC-07 E2).
search.qualityHint: The quality officer can only search — editing and origin tracing are clerk-only (BR-06).

trace.title: Origin traceability
trace.subtitle: Show the batch origin linked to its supplier, supply, quality and QR code (FR-2.9).
trace.supplyMissingHint: No supply record was selected during batch registration, so only the batch's own origin is shown.
trace.supplierMissing: The batch's supplier record could not be found
trace.originMatch: The origin matches the linked supply
trace.originMismatch: Warning: the batch origin differs from the linked supply origin.
trace.verifiedNote: This is a demo traceability view — all links are rendered from local mock data.

qr.centerSubtitle: QR status of registered batches — generate and manage codes (UC-06).
qr.screenSubtitle: Generate a QR code linked to the batch's public page, then download or print it.
qr.missingHint: Generate the batch QR code with the button below. After generation it can be previewed, downloaded and printed (UC-06).
qr.generateConfirmBody: Create a QR code for batch {code} and link it to the public page.
qr.generateError: QR generation failed. The batch record is unchanged (UC-06 E2).
qr.readyError: The QR status could not be saved. Please try again.
qr.renderError: The QR image could not be generated. Try again (UC-06 E3).
qr.readyHint: After downloading or printing, the QR code is marked «ready to use».
qr.readyDone: The QR code is ready to use.
qr.readabilityNote: The image rendered successfully, so the demo readability check is considered passed (UC-06 E3).
qr.batchMissingHint: Register a batch before generating a QR code (UC-05).
